newsitem.title: MOROCCO: Morocco's fish exports up at $886 million in '96.
newsitem.headline: Morocco's fish exports up at $886 million in '96.

text.p: Morocco's fish exports rose in value to the equivalent of US$886 million in 1996 from $749 million in 1995, the trade regulatory body said Monday.
L'Office des Changes, the trade regulator, attributed the rise to large sales of shellfish, mollusks and canned fish, mainly to the European Union and Asia.
According to provisional figures, exports in volume were around 900,000 tonnes in 1996 against 850,000 tonnes in the previous year, an official said.
Morocco also received in the same period an extra $150 million as royalties to allow the EU fishing fleet in its rich waters, he added.
